params.message:
Terms of trials that passed are looked up every day

The terms of a trial that passed were looked up only at the end of a scout run. The scheduler
starts scout when the queues are nearly empty, and with 146 trials feeding signals in they
never were: on 23 November 2026, 85 sources had passed their trial and none had its terms
looked up.

The server now starts bin/terms-round.mjs once a day from 06:00 UTC as its own process (a
model call is synchronous and would hold the server), for TW_TERMS_PER_DAY trials (10; 0 is
off). The round writes its day first, so it runs once a day. The scout run still looks up a
few as well. Nothing here admits.

Portal: De Observatory zoekt elke dag de gebruiksvoorwaarden op van bronnen die hun proef doorstonden.
